No frontend, original package registration, live Pack Manager, registry or current production-profile adoption.
The returned terminal status is retained as data; the actual result and recorded retirement were independently accepted for this scoped record only.

One actual attempt with zero automatic retries; no scientific body was rerun for publication. Interim PARTIAL.json status labels are write-ahead snapshots of that same attempt, superseded by the terminal component and packaging records.

Unchanged owner bounds: 120 s whole (initial pre-CONFIG 150 s), 90 s work, 15 s cleanup, 140 s passive witness with a launch gap of at most 20 s, 2 GiB sampled aggregate RSS, 512 KiB streams and worker JSON, 16 MiB child-file limit, at most 150 concurrently owned observed processes, one Guest.
